_comment: Scan definitions for the TennoWorth desktop app (C7). Every pattern field is OPTIONAL and absent means 'use the version compiled into the app'. This file exists so a DE parameter rename can be fixed without cutting a release: edit it on the box (it is served live from prototype/public/, see the @livedata block in deploy/Caddyfile) and clients pick it up on their next start. A pattern that does not compile, is over 512 bytes, or has too few capture groups is refused per-field and the built-in is kept, so a bad edit here cannot brick scanning. Capture-group contract: cred_pattern needs 2 (accountId, nonce), build_pattern and ct_pattern need 1 each.
